highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Coventry University dates back to 1843 when it was called the Coventry School of Design. In the 1970s and 1980s, it was a Polytechnic before gaining university status in 1992. Being the largest university in Coventry, it's also the fastest-growing in the UK and one of the largest outside London.

It has also been named the University of the Year for Student Experience by the Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide. In fact, the Guardian University Guide named it the UK's Top Modern University for seven years in a row.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value: Coventry University is so committed to inclusivity that it attracts a uniquely high number of international students through its doors every year. Over 13,000 international students from 150+ countries are represented on campus at Coventry University. You can choose to join from 75 student clubs available that represent different interests and hobbies.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Coventry University is well-known for providing excellent accommodation for its students. From studios to privately owned shared houses, the University offers different options.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options, download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The Lanchester Library at the University is a five-floor building with many different study areas. It is right at the heart of the campus and is open 24/7.

Sports
You can join over 45 sports societies, including basketball and hockey.

Laboratory
Coventry University has several labs, including the Super Laboratory (Lab+) for biomedical, pharmacological, and analytical sciences, DigiComm Lab, sport science simulation labs, Business Simulation Suite (BSS), and more.

Cafeteria
Coventry University has several cafes and dining options, including The Hub and The Bistro, for breakfast, lunch, tea, coffee, snacks, and more.
